name: A Recipe For Death
summary: In Silverpine, A Recipe For Death gathers reagents for the Forsaken's New Plague. From the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel sends bear hearts and spider blood to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

sections.title: A Weapon Against Two Foes
sections.body:
In Silverpine Forest, Apothecary Renferrel sees two foes closing on Sylvanas's people. Arthas's legions press them, while remnants of humanity remain enemies. The Forsaken have little hope in conventional warfare. They seek a New Plague that can rot living humans and undead Scourge alike.

Renferrel's field research found a virulent foundation for the plague. Arachnid venom from the Skittering Dark, joined with toxins in the hearts of native bears, forms that base.

sections.title: Dispatch to the Apothecarium
sections.body:
Bear hearts and spider blood gathered in Silverpine's wilderness travel beneath Lordaeron's ruins to the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Master Apothecary Faranell oversees the Royal Apothecary Society's design.

Faranell takes Renferrel's samples to test their contaminable properties and refine formulas. The work may secure Forsaken supremacy across the continent.

faq.q: What is the purpose of collecting bear hearts and spider blood?
faq.answer: Renferrel found that arachnid venom from the Skittering Dark reacts lethally with toxins in grizzly bear hearts. Together, they give the Royal Apothecary Society materials to test and develop the New Plague.
Master Apothecary Faranell heads the Royal Apothecary Society in the Apothecarium quarter of the Undercity. He oversees New Plague research on behalf of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want to create a New Plague?
faq.answer: The Forsaken face the Scourge and the hatred of living humans, with too few soldiers for a long conventional war. Their New Plague is meant to kill both living foes and undead Scourge, securing Forsaken survival and autonomy.
Apothecary Renferrel conducts his research from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
The Skittering Dark lies northwest of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Giant spiders infest this wilderness, and Renferrel needs their blood.
Yes. Master Apothecary Faranell uses the reagents in further experiments. Then work in the Apothecarium continues to refine and test the lethal mixture.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can help the Apothecary Society develop its plague to defend the Forsaken realm against the Scourge and humanity.
As a member of the Horde, you see Forsaken apothecaries pursue victory with virulent concoctions, a grim way of war among the Horde's newest allies.
